description: Maps where a business ranks across an area: a size x size grid of points spacingKm apart around center, one Maps search from each. Use it for rank diagnosis by distance. The browser source is free but slow and capped at 5x5; dataforseo allows up to 13x13 at $0.002 per point (a 7x7 grid is about $0.10). Call it first with estimateOnly true to get the price for the user to approve. With source dataforseo it spends from the user's own DataForSEO account inside the extension, within the monthly cap set there; a call over the cap, or with no cap set, is refused with an error saying so, and the same request within the cache window the user set in the extension (7 days unless changed) is served from the cache for nothing. spend says what was charged (null when nothing paid was called). The agent never sees the key. A large browser grid can take 10 minutes. Returns source, depth (results read at each point), cells (point with row, col, lat, lng; and rank), summary (points, ranked, notFound, unknown, averageRank over ranked points or null, top3Share of read points or null, best), estimatedCostUsd (null for browser) and spend. With estimateOnly, cells is empty and summary null. A rank is {kind: "ranked", rank}, {kind: "not_found", depth} (the list was read to depth organic results, as many as Maps listed up to the cap, and the business was not there, which is not rank 0), or {kind: "unknown", reason} (the point could not be read, or Maps cut its list short, so the business may sit just past it).

mapsUrl.description: A Google Maps link to the place, such as https://maps.app.goo.gl/... .

placeId.description: A Google place id, such as "ChIJ...".

cid.description: A Google customer id (CID), decimal digits, as in maps.google.com/?cid=.

city.description: The town or city it is in, such as "Leeds, UK".

name.description: The business name as Google shows it.

business.description: Which business: exactly one of {mapsUrl}, {placeId}, {cid} or {name, city}. Ids from find_business or local_scan are exact; a name and city is searched in Maps and can match a different place with the same name.

center.description: The middle of the grid, usually the business location.

estimateOnly.description: Return only estimatedCostUsd and read nothing, so the user can approve the spend first. Defaults to false.

query.description: The search as a customer types it into Maps, such as "emergency plumber".

size.description: Points per side, odd, 3 to 13: 5 makes 25 points. The browser source allows at most 5.

source.description: browser (the default) reads Maps in the user's Chrome for free. dataforseo pays from the user's DataForSEO key kept in the extension, within the monthly cap set there.

spacingKm.description: Kilometres between neighbouring points, more than 0 and at most 50. A 7x7 grid at 1 km spans 6 km.

zoom.description: The Maps zoom level, 3 to 21; higher is closer in. Defaults to 14, about a neighbourhood across.

name: geo_grid
title: Geo-grid rank map
